finding: The logo slot is the largest page-1 image: a near-full-page form background (554x780.1 pt) classified decorative Fresa branding because its origin y is in the bottom 16%. slotBoxes applies that logo rectangle on every page, so three pages at 150 dpi make about 5.64M masked pixels. The renderer does not draw decorative branding or other images; only barcode/QR are drawn. The golden output leaves that area blank.
